warning.titlePre: Mercedes V300 Exclusive Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The M256 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor - a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
Because the V300 EXCLUSIVE uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Vito 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established M256 specialist pattern - timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
